Author: KeydenK
Name: Beeline
Punchline: Point at anything on your map and press one button: Beeline takes you there the quickest way.
Description: Point at anything on your map and press one button (controller, mouse or keyboard): Beeline takes you there the quickest way, picking between walking, the aethernet or a teleport, then mounting, flying and walking the rest for you. Made for questing: quest markers are used at their exact position, so you end up right next to the quest NPC or object, targeted and ready to talk to, and at a safe distance from quest enemies. Works on aetherytes, aethernet shards, quest and leve markers, quest areas and any spot, in any zone. Moving your character stops the trip at once. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh. Command: /beeline
Changelog: Works with Giddy Up (new companion plugin): when it's installed it handles Sprint and Peloton (each one it uses) and dismounting for enemies during your trips, Beeline shares its learned speeds with it, and a trip ends when Giddy Up gets you off your mount for a fight. Being attacked doesn't stop a trip; a new option (off by default) stops it when you target an enemy (with Giddy Up: once that enemy is within your attack range), so you can start the fight; with it off, Giddy Up leaves you on the mount for the whole trip. Smoother take-off: Beeline takes off right away once mounted (whether the game takes off on the first jump or on a double jump), keeps walking while the mount comes, and no longer turns back when a trip starts while you're already mounted. Quest markers without a named target: Beeline looks for the quest object or NPC on the way and heads straight to it as soon as the game loads it. Controller: a press only counts when the map has the focus. Flying to an NPC or object, Beeline lands at talking distance instead of in its face. New option (off by default): the time left for a trip in the server info bar. "Dismount when you target an enemy" moved to Giddy Up, which does it at your attack range. A quest clicked from another map now leads to the right floor in layered cities (the marker is looked up again once there). Holding both mouse buttons (the game's mouse walk) now stops a trip too, like the stick and movement keys. Logging out ends a trip right away. Fixes: a trip that can't find a flying path no longer switches between flying and the ground forever; a mount that never comes no longer leaves you following the flying path on foot; mount retries are timed correctly after a re-route; the learned Sprint duration is saved. Every end of a trip is written to the log with its reason. A press on a main aetheryte icon is now left to the game's own teleport (Beeline no longer starts a second one); aethernet shards are still Beeline's. While taking off, the game's "Cannot execute at this time." (vnavmesh's refused Jump presses) and "Unable to use. You are currently using another item." (another plugin's action during the mount summon) are hidden for a few seconds; nothing else is. The map safety net no longer raises a false alarm when Beeline reloads with the map open, and a controller press with the map's crosshair hidden says so.
